name: JE-8086
author: sd88me
summary: An emulation of the Roland JP-8000's original firmware (gearmulator's JE-8086 core) as a native instrument for Gen2 MPC devices, with a touchscreen skin in the JP-8000's look, envelope graphs, named favourites, RANDOM and INIT, tempo sync and Q-Link control. Gen2 (aarch64) only; you need your own JP-8000 ROM.
